title: Compatibility of the projection comparison with a composite restricted pullback.
statement: For the two cartesian squares of f and g, compatible map of their pullbacks and the two local objects, the constructed composite stage map followed by the fixed projection comparison equals the natural overlap comparison followed by pullback of the fixed f-stage object comparison. The equation is expressed using the supplied isomorphism parameters and their constructor equalities; it holds on either Boolean branch. It involves no gluing map psi or theta. The local identification data supply only the common source interface.

source.place: Compatibility of derived pullback and open restriction; composition as in Tag 0D5S.

proof.text: Substitute the three constructor equalities. Apply perfectOverlapCompositeCounitFactor on the chosen Boolean branch to factor the full stage map as eta, inverse transport, and the explicitly constructed tail.
Apply perfectOverlapTailProjectionComponent on that branch. This is the geometric prism calculation before the site counit: tail followed by chi equals transport followed by pullback of sigma.

Substitute the two equations, reassociate, and cancel inverse transport followed by transport. The resulting component is eta followed by pullback of sigma, as required. The private combineComponents lemma is this elementary calculation in an arbitrary category.

proof_origin.place: Parent steps 1--3, with the site-counit interface and the geometric tail separated.
proof_origin.note: Typed reduction into two strictly partial obligations; the combining proof is complete.
